About

Learning Hub runs entirely from this file — no server, no hosting. Messages relay through PubNub's free public demo sandbox, so skip anything sensitive. Chat history, photos, and these settings are saved only in this browser. When you reopen the app, it tries to catch you up on anything you missed — first through PubNub's own message history if it's available on this shared demo key, and as a backup, by asking any friend who's currently online to relay what they have.
